reports.subject: Grease Interceptor Service & Findings

sections.title: Service Performed
sections.body: Sewer Squad Services LLC was dispatched to the above location to pump out and service the facility's grease interceptor (grease trap). The interceptor was fully evacuated and its contents transported and disposed of in accordance with all applicable TCEQ and City of Houston regulations.

sections.title: Findings
sections.body:
During service, our technicians observed active sanitary sewer flow discharging INTO the grease interceptor from the City of Houston sanitary line. Under normal design conditions, flow should move away from the interceptor toward the municipal sanitary main. The reverse condition observed on site indicates a defect in the sanitary line configuration serving this property.

Based on field observations, the condition appears attributable to one or more of the following:
• Improper sanitary line slope. The sanitary lateral does not appear to maintain the minimum required downward gradient toward the city main. As a result, effluent cannot drain by gravity and is flowing back into the grease interceptor.
• Possible obstruction in the City of Houston sanitary main. A partial or full blockage within the municipal sanitary line may be restricting flow, causing wastewater to back up and overflow into the grease interceptor.

Either condition, or a combination of both, will result in recurring backups, overflow, and premature filling of the grease interceptor regardless of pumping frequency. The underlying sanitary line issue must be corrected to resolve the problem.

sections.title: Recommended Corrective Action
sections.body:
• Perform a camera (CCTV) inspection of the sanitary lateral and its connection to the city main to confirm slope/grade and to locate any obstruction.
• Correct the sanitary line slope so it meets plumbing code gradient requirements toward the city main.
• If an obstruction in the city main is confirmed, coordinate with the City of Houston for line clearing or repair.
• Verify that the grease interceptor is properly isolated from sanitary flow once corrections are complete.

reports.closing: This report reflects conditions observed at the time of service and is provided to assist in diagnosing and correcting the sanitary line issue. Sewer Squad Services LLC is available to perform the camera inspection and any follow-up work required.

reports.subject: Sample Well & City Connection

sections.title: Service Overview
sections.body: Sewer Squad Services LLC inspected the sample well and the property's connection to the City of Houston sanitary main at the above location. This report documents our findings and outlines the recommended corrective work.

sections.title: Findings
sections.body: Upon inspection, our technicians found the sample well and the connection to the city line completely clogged with accumulated debris and toilet paper. This blockage is restricting flow through the line and is the likely source of the backups being experienced at the property. Left unaddressed, a blockage of this severity will continue to cause backups, slow drainage, and the risk of overflow.

sections.title: Recommended Service
sections.body:
We recommend a thorough, high-pressure hydro jetting and mechanical snaking of the sample well and the connection to the city line. Hydro jetting scours the full interior of the pipe, cutting through compacted debris and paper and flushing it clear, while snaking breaks up and removes any remaining obstruction. In the majority of cases, this service fully restores flow and resolves the issue.

Should the blockage prove more extensive, or should the line show signs of a deeper structural problem, we can perform a full camera (CCTV) inspection to pinpoint the exact location and cause. This gives you a clear, documented picture of the line's condition before any further work is authorized — no guesswork, no surprises.

sections.title: Pricing
sections.body:
• Hydro jetting & snaking of the sample well and connection to the city line — $799.99 (flat rate).
• Camera (CCTV) inspection, if further diagnosis is needed — available for an additional charge.
• Any additional work identified beyond the scope above will be quoted separately for your approval before we proceed.

sections.title: Our Warranty
sections.body: All of our work is backed by a 90-day warranty. If the same issue returns within 90 days of service, we will make it right. We use commercial-grade equipment, dispose of all waste in full compliance with TCEQ and City of Houston regulations, and stand behind every job we complete.

reports.closing: We would be glad to schedule this service and get your line flowing clean and clear. Call 346-244-5579 or email Sales@sewersquadservices.com to book — our team is ready when you are.
